title: Redis RDB (snapshot) signature
summary: A Redis RDB file begins with the 5-byte signature 'REDIS' (0x52 0x45 0x44 0x49 0x53) followed by a 4-byte version number (e.g., '0009' for RDB version 9).
source_version: Wikipedia List of file signatures, retrieved 2026-05-29

notes: RDB is a point-in-time snapshot of the Redis dataset.
RDB files are compact (binary format) and fast to load.
RDB version 9 is used by Redis 7.0+.
